## Why pixel correlation is required (hash-similar candidate pairs)

79,018 image pairs have perceptual hashes within 12 bits. Pairs that also have high pixel correlation essentially never disagree on the label; low-correlation pairs are different brains.

| Pixel correlation | Pairs | Pairs with different labels |
|---|---|---|
| -1.00 – 0.80 | 59,764 | 30,015 |
| 0.80 – 0.90 | 8,792 | 2,851 |
| 0.90 – 0.95 | 2,853 | 61 |
| 0.95 – 0.98 | 2,190 | 1 |
| 0.98 – 1.00 | 5,419 | 0 |
